title: Trip to the Zoo
description: A fun adventure to the zoo

fields.prompt: Pick something someone would yell when they are excited.

template:
{name1} and {name2} took a trip to the zoo. They saw many animals and had
a great time.

First, they visited the {adjective} {animal}. The {animal} was named
{name2}, and {name2} was {verb.ingTense} all over the enclosure. "{exclamation}!"
shouted {name1}. "Look at {name2} go!"

Next they heard a loud {noise} from {place}. The {job} was chasing a runaway
cart full of {food}. "{exclamation}!" yelled the {job}. "My {food} is escaping!"

{name1} and {name2} helped catch the cart. As a thank-you, the {job} gave
them one {thing} to take home and let them feed the {animal} some {food}.
{name2} the {animal} gobbled up the {food} and started {verb} again,
happier than ever.

On the way home, {name1} said, "That was the best zoo trip ever." And
{name2} agreed: "{exclamation}!"
